220320101.text: Ahh, it would be nice to have some Liyue cuisine...

220320103.text: You are? With that outfit... You're the Traveler, right? Sorry, I'm just a little homesick...

220320118.text: Huh? Could it be... You know how to make Liyue cuisine? That's great!

220320119.text: Th-Then, please help me! Please make me some authentic Liyue dishes!

220320120.text: Let me think... What I really want to eat now is...

220320121.text: Hmm... I want to eat fish! I miss the fish my mom made when I was a kid...

220320122.text: Wash the fish, make slashes on both sides, stuff with spices and aged wine and marinate slightly, fry in a pan until golden brown...

220320123.text: Then, add hot water and sauce to simmer. Finally, season over high heat, thicken the sauce, plate, and serve... Ah, that's the real deal!

220320124.text: My younger brother would jump and cheer "It's ready! The food's ready!"

220320125.text: *sobs* My mom is really good at cooking fish, but when can I go back to eat it?

220320106.text: Let me introduce myself. I'm Tang Wen, a historian from Liyue. I was previously doing some field research on the unique customs and folklore of Inazuma.

220320107.text: I was about to return to Liyue as I had almost finished collecting information. But because of Inazuma's Sakoku Decree, I ended up being stranded here for a long time...

220320108.text: Actually, I think this is kind of a good thing for me. It's because I feel that this is a historic moment for Inazuma!

220320109.text: I am quite sure that this particular period will certainly leave a strong mark in the annals of history of Teyvat.

220320110.text: To witness such history with one's own eyes, and then record all of it in a true, complete and clear manner for posterity, is what a historian should do.

220320111.text: But... as exciting as this cause is to me, it won't satisfy my stomach...

220320113.text: I can't say... it's because I'm hungry... Hahaha, Inazuma's food is quite tasty too.

220320114.text: I really like the tempura here, although it feels like everything is coated with batter and then fried...

220320115.text: But after eating Inazuma cuisine for a long time, I started to miss the Liyue dishes. Sadly, I couldn't find a restaurant that could make authentic Liyue cuisine.

220320116.text: I finally decided to post a Cuisine Commission at the Adventurers' Guild a few days ago but there hasn't been any response...

220320117.text: Can I give it a try?

220320701.text: So, which dish should we prepare that is cooked with fish? How about we choose one for her?

220320702.text: Let's see... Paimon's favorite fish dishes lately are...

220320705.text: And the almighty Mondstadt Grilled Fish!

220320706.text: Aren't these all your favorite food?

220320707.text: Hehe, just trust in Paimon's taste! Hurry and choose one~

220320709.text: Sounds great! Let's quickly make Black-Back Perch Stew for Miss Tang Wen!

220320711.text: Yay! Let's quickly make Squirrel Fish for Miss Tang Wen!

220320713.text: Nice! Let's quickly make Mondstadt Grilled Fish for Miss Tang Wen!

220320715.text: Hmm, let's make the dish for Miss Tang Wen after deciding!

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220320201.text: Back so soon? You're not a secret chef, are you?

220320202.text: Hmmm... I can't wait, please let me try it!

220320205.text: Oh right... Squirrel Fish, Black-Back Perch Stew, and Mondstadt Grilled Fish!

220320206.text: Let's decide and give it to Miss Tang Wen!

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220320301.text: Ah! This is it! This, this is the taste of home I've been dreaming of... It's... *sob* I'm so touched...

220320302.text: Thank you so much! I feel energized with all this good food.

220320303.text: These are for you. I wish you a smooth journey ahead!

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220320401.text: Hmm, this taste... well, it doesn't seem to taste like a Liyue or Inazuma dish. The taste is really new to me...

220320402.text: Although it isn't the cuisine I wanted to eat, I'm already satisfied to be able to taste such a novel dish.

220320403.text: Thank you, Traveler. Please accept these.

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the completed dish back to Tang Wen

220320501.text: Eh? I think this is still an Inazuma dish...

220320502.text: I don't think this is the dish I asked for... Well, never mind, this dish is also filling...

220320503.text: Thanks anyway, Traveler. Please take these.

220320601.text: Hmm? Why does th—this dish taste... so... so interesting.

220320602.text: Can't say it's interesting... Uhh, I should say...unique, or something...

220320603.text: How did you come up with such a dish? Your cooking skills are really...out of this world...

220320604.text: Thanks for your hard work! Traveler, please take these. I'll umm, savor this dish later...

220320801.text: Ahh, it would be nice to have some Liyue cuisine about now...

220320803.text: Huh, that outfit... You're the Traveler, aren't you? I'm sorry, I'm just feeling a little homesick right now...

220320820.text: Let me think... What I'd really like to eat right now is...

220320822.text: She'd wash the fish, make slashes on both sides, stuff it with spices and aged wine and marinate slightly, fry it in a pan until golden brown...

220320823.text: Then, she'd add hot water and sauce to simmer, before finally seasoning over high heat, thickening the sauce, plating, and serving... Ah, that's the real deal!

220320806.text: Ah, right. Allow me to me introduce myself. I'm Tang Wen, a historian from Liyue. Previously, I was doing some field research on the unique customs and folklore of Inazuma.

220320807.text: I'd finished collecting all the material I needed, in fact, and was preparing to head back to Liyue. But so many big things have happened in Inazuma recently...

220320808.text: So I feel like I'm living in historic times here, you know?

220320809.text: The happenings of this particular period will certainly leave a strong mark in the annals of Teyvat's history.

220320810.text: To witness such history with one's own eyes, and then record all of it in a true, complete, and clear manner for posterity — that is what a historian should do.

220320811.text: But... as exciting as this cause is to me, it won't satisfy my stomach...

220320813.text: Well, I wouldn't say that exactly... Inazuma's food is actually pretty tasty.

220320814.text: I really like the tempura here, although it's, well... They just wrap everything in batter and fry it, you know?

220320815.text: But after eating Inazuman cuisine for a long time, I started to miss dishes from back home. Sadly, I couldn't find a restaurant here that could make authentic Liyue cuisine.

220320816.text: So I finally decided to post a "cuisine commission" at the Adventurers' Guild a few days ago, but there hasn't been any response since...

220320817.text: May I give it a try?
